style.name: 莓果气泡
style.css: #root{--ink:#fff7f6;--muted:#f4d5de;--accent:#ffb5ca;height:100%;width:100%;padding:17px;border:1px solid #fff1f254;border-radius:9px;background:#492c48d9;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);color:var(--ink);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff42,0 9px 30px #0002}#root:before{content:'';position:absolute;right:-22%;bottom:-30%;width:85%;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:50%;opacity:.35;pointer-events:none}#root:after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-7%;bottom:-41%;width:90%;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:50%;opacity:.15;pointer-events:none}.heading,.footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;z-index:1;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);gap:5px}.heading .emblem{color:var(--accent);font-size:23px}.count{margin-left:auto;white-space:nowrap}.hero{position:relative;z-index:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}.orb{font-size:60px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;color:var(--accent);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 0 23px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent),transparent 70%)}.idle .orb{font-weight:400}.message{font-size:18px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:3;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.more{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;gap:4px}.extra{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;border-top:1px solid #fff1f254;padding-top:5px}.footer{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.08em}.foot-right{color:var(--accent)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.emblem{animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes twinkle{to{opacity:.45;transform:rotate(25deg)}}}
